items.snippet_en: UNICEF Montenegro reported that 5G technology does not cause or spread the coronavirus.
The World Health Organization confirmed that no adverse health effects have been causally linked to exposure to wireless technologies, including 5G.
The International Telecommunications Union stated that 5G is not responsible for spreading COVID-19, designating the claim a hoax with no technical basis.
Healthline explained that viruses spread via respiratory droplets rather than wireless networks, and there is no evidence that 5G influences viral infection risks.
Full Fact found no evidence linking 5G to COVID-19, pointing out that the virus was actively spreading in regions without 5G networks.
Scientific evidence and health organizations have widely debunked claims that 5G causes or spreads coronavirus.
Scientific literature and health organizations have debunked the claim that 5G technology transmits or causes COVID-19.
Claims linking 5G towers to the coronavirus have been thoroughly debunked by health authorities and scientific evidence.
Claims that 5G spreads or causes COVID-19 are scientifically debunked conspiracy theories.
Scientific analysis debunks the claim that 5G causes or spreads COVID-19.
Health organizations and scientific evidence debunk assertions that 5G causes or transmits the coronavirus.
Scientific consensus debunks claims connecting 5G signals to the spread or causation of COVID-19.

outputs.notes_en: All sources directly contradict the claim that 5G technology or towers spread the coronavirus, confirming that biological viruses cannot be transmitted via radio waves and that COVID-19 spread in locations without 5G.
